source.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification
source.review_method: Manual visual inspection of rendered PDF pages; pdftotext -layout was used only as a reading aid and not as the source of fixture boundaries.
source.license_note: This ledger records facts and short transcriptions from the OMG specification for conformance work; preserve the specification copyright and license notices when redistributing source excerpts.

scope.scope_boundary: The requested page interval is broader than the assigned clause interval. Printed pages 43-44 are 7.6.6-7.6.8 and printed pages 61-74 are 7.12-7.14; they were visually checked for boundaries but are excluded from entries. The page-60/61 continuation of 7.11.2 is included.

status_vocabulary.complete: A closed textual declaration or block as printed. Referenced definitions may be outside the block and are listed in dependencies.
status_vocabulary.complete_template: A closed textual notation block whose syntax is complete but intentionally schematic, using placeholders such as /* members */, /* ... */, AttributeDef1, or value1.
status_vocabulary.incomplete: A source fragment cut by a page boundary or otherwise missing required continuation. In-scope fragments are recorded under non_fixture_observations and linked to a merged entry.
status_vocabulary.diagram_label: Text visible in a graphical-notation column or diagram, not a textual SysML source block.
status_vocabulary.external_language: A language/representation body that is not SysML textual notation. None were found in the included clauses.

omissions_and_ambiguities: The PDF's printed-page interval and clause interval do not align: 7.7 begins on printed page 45, while 7.11.2 continues onto printed page 61. This ledger follows the explicit clause range and includes the cross-page 7.11.2 example.

Table textual-notation cells sometimes show alternate spellings in one cell. Each alternative that is independently closed was recorded as its own entry where practical; repeated individual-definition text on printed pages 51 and 52 is intentional table content and is retained.

Generic names and values in representative notation (for example AttributeDef1, EnumerationDef1, OccurDef, PartDef1, value1, and unit1) are dependencies/placeholders, not claims that those definitions exist in the surrounding block.
Whitespace was normalized when narrow table columns wrapped a declaration. Comments, punctuation, quoted names, multiplicities, and relationship operators were retained.
No standalone entry is made for graphical labels, diagram-only text, or the standalone page-bottom fragment that was merged into the complete Vehicle example.
